name: Palma di Montechiaro (Italy)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, green above and light blue below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Palma di Montechiaro (palm trees on light blue) in a yellow oval within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Palma di Montechiaro, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.
